a: The Acuity Institute is an independent project, founded by Ethan James Farrell, dedicated to truth and the expansion of accurate knowledge. Its first offering is the Acuity Library, an open reading library of wisdom traditions.

q: Is the Acuity Library free to use?
a: Yes. Every text in the Library is free to read in the browser and to download. No account is needed and nothing is tracked.

The Library holds 607 texts and presentations (510 texts and 97 research presentations) across eight collections: Sacred Texts, Esoteric, Presentations, Scripture, Philosophy, Original Works, Health and Miscellaneous. Each text is available as PDF, EPUB or both, and the Sacred Texts collection also includes Markdown sources.

Acuity.Agent is the Institute's AI knowledge assistant for exploring sacred texts, philosophy and spiritual traditions. It searches a library of more than 20,000 sacred texts, reads the relevant passages and develops answers with traceable source references. It is not yet open to the public; you can join the waitlist on this page.

q: Are the Instruments of Clarity available yet?
a: No. The Instruments of Clarity are under development. They are planned as a single interface, with The Archive, The Lens, myVault, Context Spheres and Studio as its facets, building on the Library and Acuity.Agent.

q: Does the e-book reader remember my place?
a: Only if you choose "Remember my place on this device". Your font size and position in the book are then saved in your own browser and are not sent to the Institute. Unticking the option removes the saved entry.
